verdict: One issue needs attention soon, plus 5 smaller one(s).

findings.title: /mnt/sdc1 is 99.5% full
findings.body: The drive at /mnt/sdc1 has only 3.8 GiB free.
findings.action: Free space or move data elsewhere.

findings.title: /media/buengenio/sda4 is 90.5% full
findings.body: The drive at /media/buengenio/sda4 has only 62.9 GiB free.
findings.action: Free space or move data elsewhere.

findings.title: Processor is about 9 years old
findings.body: The Intel Core i7-7500U came out around 2017. It still works, but newer chips do the same work in a fraction of the time and power.

findings.title: Battery holds 45.3% of its original capacity
findings.body: The battery has worn down: it now holds 25.9 Wh of the 57.0 Wh it was built with, after 1729 charge cycles. Expect short runtimes.
findings.action: Replace the battery if portability matters.

findings.title: System is under heavy load
findings.body: The computer is working harder than it can keep up with right now.

findings.title: Waiting on disks 34.7% of the time
findings.body: A large part of the time, the processor is just waiting for a disk to respond.

findings.title: Memory cannot be upgraded
findings.body: The 16 GB of memory is built into the board, so it can't be increased later.

findings.title: Drive health could not be read
findings.body: Innards couldn't check the health of your drives. Running it with administrator rights, or installing smartmontools, enables this.
findings.action: Install smartmontools and rerun with elevated rights.

findings.title: Only 2 CPU cores
findings.body: This processor has 2 cores. Heavy tasks that split across many cores will feel slow.

findings.title: Graphics are built into the processor
findings.body: Graphics come from the processor itself (HD Graphics 620). Fine for video and desktop work; not for modern games or AI training.

findings.title: Swap is configured
findings.body: Your computer has 12.0 GiB of backup memory space, so it won't crash the moment memory runs out.

findings.title: Fast NVMe system drive
findings.body: The main drive (KINGSTON SNV2S2000G, 1.8 TiB) is the fast modern kind.
